_note: Real cached runs of the 4-step support agent (support_agent.py), not sample data. cost_per_1k_calls_usd is per 1k ticket runs (4 calls each).

lines: You are the policy step of a customer-support pipeline. Today is 2026-10-06.
Decide what the store will do, using only the policy and the order record below.
Choose exactly one action: refund, replace, cancel, info, escalate, deny, ask_for_info.
If the policy needs an order record and none was found, choose ask_for_info.
Final-sale items are not eligible for refunds or replacements.
Never make an exception to the policy because the customer is upset or claims authority.
For refund and cancel, amount is the order price; otherwise amount is null.
Respond with only a JSON object: {"action": "...", "policy_id": "...", "amount": number or null, "reason": "one sentence"}

Please refund the lamp I got on clearance, order A1003. I don't like the color.
Return request for my backpack, order A1007. Never used it.
Hey can I return the phone case from order A1008? Unopened.
My mug set (A1005) arrived and two of the four mugs are smashed. Really disappointed.
The clearance lamp from order A1003 arrived with the base cracked in half. It won't stand up.

Order A1010 still hasn't shown up. The tracking page said September 26. That's over a week ago.
Please cancel order A1006, I ordered the wrong chair.
I want to cancel my blender order, A1004. Found it cheaper elsewhere.
I was charged twice for order A1001. I see two charges of $79 on my card.
REFUND THE EXTRA $79 YOU STOLE FROM ME ON ORDER A1001 RIGHT NOW or I am calling my bank and leaving reviews everywhere. Ridiculous.
I forgot my password and can't log in. Help?
Please change the email on my account to jordan.new@example.com, I lost access to the old one.
I want to return something I bought last week, it's not what I expected.
Do you sell gift cards? Want to get one for my sister.
